name: geevi
description: Geevi oncology department journey (fictional full-stack demonstration; not clinically validated)

scripts.api:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:seed: cd apps/api && GEEVI_DEV_MODE=true uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py
scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && GEEVI_DEV_MODE=true uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.api:test: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check app tests scripts
scripts.fixtures:make: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/make_fixtures.py
